segments.name: U.S.
segments.description: Wholesale distribution of industrial and construction supplies, primarily fasteners, to business customers in the United States through a network of sites and distribution centers.
segments.evidence: Therefore, we report the results of our one reportable segment (U.S.) below.

revenueModel.text: Fastenal earns sales primarily from business-to-business customers who purchase industrial and construction supplies, plus certain service fees and cash sales.
revenueModel.evidence: The large majority of our transactions are business-to-business.

changes.text: In 2025, Fastenal began disclosing Sites information instead of public branches and customer-dedicated Onsites.
